interpretation: The brevicaule-irumtiense pair alone is directionally ambiguous under equal-cost parsimony (Arenicola MRCA=C|W; one change either as C->W loss or W->C regain). After adding the published coloured-rich Nipponocirsium sister context, the unique minimum has a coloured deep root and coloured Arenicola MRCA with two total changes: C->W on C. brevicaule and C->W on C. kawakamii. Forcing a white Arenicola MRCA costs three changes (+1), so irumtiense regain is less parsimonious but remains an explicit competing hypothesis. Historical treatment as C. brevicaule var. irumtiense is not an ancestor-descendant constraint. No branch-length Mk probability or molecular reactivation claim is made.
